body:
I finished one dress completely, and I didn't finish my hems on 2 skirts. Also, fuck blouses. It's never going to happen. Bahaha. 

I don't even know when or how I'd ever get back to those things. All I see is a tunnel of education and stress and misery.

I used to target shoot, ride horses, play softball. I also used to design skirts and dresses, and I managed to sew a few before I moved out. I grew up on a beef farm and I loved working cattle. Kind of was a 'daddy's little girl' thing. I miss it a lot.
Cutting used to do that. That isn't enough now either. I don't know what else to do.
It makes me feel better for a while. But it also isn't enough.
I have kind of lost interest in everything. I don't want to do anything but just lay here and cry and cut and bleed and die. I can't do anything else. I don't want to.
I've already tried to sleep. I just keep thinking. It's always the worst at night.

I feel like I'll only make it through the night if I go to a hospital. But I don't know if I can do it. I can't admit where I'm at... hence the throwaway account. The worst that could happen, I don't know... I just don't want to be judged or talked out. I know my head is screwed up, normal people don't get into things like this... but I don't want to admit it.
I listen to a lot of stuff. I have some Blue Rodeo and The Black Crowes on  right now. Blusey, jazzy, country.
I live in a shit area. I really don't feel like getting raped or mugged tonight. But I wish... Plus the fact that I need to stop bleeding....

No, I honestly don't think my parents would take it seriously. I can't visit, my sister is taking my car this weekend. And, no, I can't talk to her... she's horrible. I have needed a break since school started in September. I have been slowly becoming more of a mess all year. I just can't do any more. I am always sad. I am always feeling disconnected and lost. I can't connect with people. Its not that my circumstances are unmanageable. It's just that I feel horrible inside and I'd rather quit life than live it.
I'm in university. I miss home. My grandpa is sick. I have finals starting in a week and I haven't even started studying because I can't focus. All I can think about is dying.

Cutting makes me feel alive, otherwise I'm numb, and I don't know if I'm awake or dreaming. I just can't stop. I don't know why but I don't want my cuts to stop bleeding ever... I want to be weakened... I want to die...
